description: Zhang Fei, stocky Chinese warrior, approved pixel art. Front view. Black beard and topknot, red headband with two tails, dark gold-trimmed armor, red cloth, boots, long dark spear with large silver serpent blade.
action: One battle roar, not a spear attack. Follow skeleton. Frames1-4 gather breath, RIGHT hand keeps same spear grip, LEFT hand is free. Frames5-6 lift LEFT foot for one outward side step, RIGHT foot stays planted throughout. Frame7 left foot contacts ground; frames7-13 hold planted stance. Frames8-11 open chest and raise free LEFT fist in a strong shout. Keep spear upright beside body, no strike or spin. Frame14 left foot lifts to return, frame15 exact supplied idle. Preserve torso and limb lengths. Headband knot remains on head and both tails follow attached points. Mouth opens slightly only during shout, eyes stay open and face shape/beard preserved; mouth closes before idle. Fixed south/front camera and pivot, no jump, no camera movement, no effects or afterimages.
